title: Representation Finetuning for Continual Learning
abstract: arXiv:2603.11201v3 Announce Type: replace-cross  Abstract: The world is inherently dynamic, and continual learning aims to enable models to adapt to ever-evolving data streams. While pre-trained models have shown powerful performance in continual learning, they still require finetuning to adapt effectively to downstream tasks. However, prevailing Parameter-Efficient Fine-Tuning (PEFT) methods operate through empirical, black-box optimization at the weight level. These approaches lack explicit control over representation drift, leading to sensitivity to domain shifts and catastrophic forgetting in continual learning scenarios. In this work, we introduce Continual Representation Learning (CoRe), a novel framework that for the first time shifts the finetuning paradigm from weight space to representation space. translated_title: 面向持续学习的表征微调
translated_abstract: arXiv:2603.11201v3 公告类型：替换交叉 摘要：世界本质上是动态的，持续学习旨在使模型能够适应不断演变的数据流。虽然预训练模型在持续学习中表现出强大的性能，但它们仍需微调以有效适应下游任务。然而，流行的参数高效微调（PEFT）方法通过经验性的、黑盒式的权重级优化进行运作。这些方法缺乏对表征漂移的显式控制，导致在持续学习场景中对领域偏移敏感且易发生灾难性遗忘。在这项工作中，我们引入了持续表征学习（CoRe），这是一种新颖的框架，首次将微调范式从权重空间转移到表征空间。与传统方法不同，CoRe在隐藏表征的低秩线性子空间内执行任务特定的干预，采用具有显式目标的学习过程。
tldr: 本文提出CoRe框架，首次将持续学习中的微调从权重空间转移到表征空间，通过低秩子空间干预实现显式控制表征漂移，从而缓解领域偏移和灾难性遗忘。
en_tdlr: This paper proposes the CoRe framework, which for the first time shifts finetuning in continual learning from weight space to representation space, enabling explicit control of representation drift via low-rank subspace interventions to mitigate domain shift and catastrophic forgetting.
